description: This file defines API endpoints for managing stories, episodes, and user choices in a storytelling platform. It includes data models, route handlers for listing stories, retrieving specific stories and episodes, and submitting user choices, with database interactions using SQLModel and FastAPI.

classes.name: ChoiceModel
classes.description: Represents a choice option within an episode, including choice ID, text, next episode index, and XP delta.

classes.name: EpisodeModel
classes.description: Represents an episode within a story, including ID, index, content, and available choices.

classes.name: StoryModel
classes.description: Simplified model representing a story with ID, title, and description.

classes.name: StoryDetailModel
classes.description: Extended story model including episodes, for detailed view.

classes.name: SubmitChoiceRequest
classes.description: Request model for submitting a choice, including selected choice ID.

classes.name: SubmitChoiceResponse
classes.description: Response model after submitting a choice, including story ID, next episode index, current XP, whether the story reached the end, and next episode details.

methods.name: User get_demo_user(x_demo_user: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Demo-User"))
methods.description: Retrieves a demo user from the request header, or raises an authentication error.

methods.name: list_stories()
methods.description: Returns a list of all available stories.

methods.name: get_story(story_id: int = Path(..., ge=1))
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a specific story, including its episodes and choices.

methods.name: get_episode(story_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), ep_index: int = Path(..., ge=0))
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific episode within a story, including choices.

methods.name: submit_choice(payload: SubmitChoiceRequest, user: User = Depends(get_demo_user), story_id: int = Path(..., ge=1))
methods.description: Handles a user's choice submission, updates XP and progression, and returns the next episode info.

ctags.name: choice_id
ctags.pattern: /^    choice_id: int = Field(..., description="Selected choice id")$/

ctags.name: get_demo_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_demo_user(x_demo_user: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Demo-User")) -> User:$/

ctags.name: get_episode
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_episode(story_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), ep_index: int = Path(..., ge=0)):$/
ctags.signature: (story_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), ep_index: int = Path(..., ge=0))

ctags.name: submit_choice
ctags.pattern: /^async def submit_choice(payload: SubmitChoiceRequest, user: User = Depends(get_demo_user), story/
ctags.signature: (payload: SubmitChoiceRequest, user: User = Depends(get_demo_user), story_id: int = Path(..., ge=1))
